summary: Phase 0 evidence collection for the sales-order ↔ manufacturing-order (SO↔MO) linkage contract. Catalogs schemas, DAL functions, API routes, UI forms, DB tables, the bug fix 948c155e (sales-linked MO ingredient loading), the salesOrderLineId one-time-claim invariant, the product picker filter for products with non-empty active BOMs, sales-order draft line rewrites (delete+reinsert) and snapshot re-link behavior, and item soft-delete blocks driven by draft/released MOs. No interpretation, scenario generation, or test design — only factual extraction with citations.

evidence.claim: salesOrderId has FK to salesOrders.id; salesOrderLineId is a uuid column with NO foreign key — intentional, so sales-order edits that hard-delete+reinsert lines do not violate FK constraints. Comment lines 40-41 documents the design.

Validates linkage in three branches: (1) both nulls → return null (unlinked); (2) one null → throw 400 with field error; (3) both set → look up by id+id; success requires salesOrders.deletedAt IS NULL AND salesOrders.status='open' AND salesOrderLines.itemId === productId. On miss, if the caller passed `existingSnapshot` matching the same {salesOrderId, salesOrderLineId} (i.e. the snapshot is unchanged), it falls back to looking up ANY open line on the same SO with same productId; if found, returns that; otherwise returns the existing snapshot unchanged. Otherwise throws 404 with field error 'Select an active sales order line for this product'.

Commit 948c155e removed the explicit block 'if (payload.salesOrderId != null || payload.salesOrderLineId != null) throw ManufacturingError("Create sales-linked manufacturing orders from the sales order Create MOs flow.", 400)'. After the fix, single-MO create can pass salesOrderId+salesOrderLineId directly through POST /api/manufacturing-orders.

isSalesOrderMode is now `!isEditing && watchedSalesOrderId != null && watchedSalesOrderLineId == null` (previously only required watchedSalesOrderId). handleSalesLineChange now fills productId/plannedQuantity from the picked line and seeds ingredients from productMap.get(line.itemId).bom. ingredientOptions now also includes ingredientItemOptions (from getAvailableComponents) so non-BOM ingredients are pickable. The mutation payload (lines 595-596 in new) now uses `values.salesOrderId, values.salesOrderLineId` instead of nulling them.
Now fetches getAvailableComponents() and getManufacturingSalesLineOptions() in parallel and passes them as ingredientItemOptions / salesLineOptions to ManufacturingOrderForm.

Filters manufacturingOrders WHERE salesOrderLineId IN (...) AND deletedAt IS NULL AND status IN ('open','done'). This defines the one-time claim: any non-deleted MO whose status is 'open' or 'done' blocks re-creation for that sales line. Cancellation reopens it (because deletedAt becomes set).

Reservable on-hand for the item is computed at the default inventory_location (filtered by disposition='available'), minus demandOutsideSelection. If remainingStock >= orderedQuantity, skipReason='stock_on_hand'. If remainingStock > 0 but < orderedQuantity, manufacturingQuantity is set to the uncovered portion. The skip is recomputed against a running tally per item.

Locks salesOrders row FOR UPDATE. Throws ManufacturingError if status != 'open'. Iterates summary.lines and inserts one MO per selected line via insertManufacturingOrderInTx with salesLink snapshot {salesOrderId, salesOrderLineId, salesOrderNumber, customerName}. Returns {created:[], skipped:[]} where skipped[] always contains lines that were unselectable (skipReason set) regardless of selection.

Requires existing.status === 'open' (line 3840). Blocks if any pickAllocations exist (3850-3862) OR any non-pending batch row exists (3863-3875). Re-runs validateSalesLineLinkInTx with the existing snapshot so unchanged-snapshot drift falls back. Deletes ingredients and re-inserts. Calls cancelActiveStockAllocations for old ingredients and addIngredientDemandForManufacturing for new ones. Updates salesOrderNumber / salesCustomerName columns from the new salesLink.

After locking the order row, releases existing reservations, then deletes shipment lines + planned shipments + ALL salesOrderLines for the order, then inserts new lines (line 6139 deletes, 6141-6154 inserts). Calls moveReplacedSalesLineAllocationsInTx to migrate allocations from old line ids to new line ids where itemId matches. Throws SalesError('Done orders cannot be changed.') when status='done'.

Locks manufacturingOrders FOR UPDATE filtered by salesOrderId IN (...). If any linked MO has salesOrderLineId NULL or pointing to a line not in the SO's current line ids, returns the canonical 'not to a matching active sales line. Remove or repair the manufacturing link first.' error. Also rejects if any active stockAllocation on the linked MO points to a different sales line. Otherwise delegates to deleteManufacturingOrdersInTx (which itself enforces production-history protection rules).

Refuses to soft-delete when ANY of: status != 'open', completedAt not null, actualQuantity > 0, any batch is completed/has lotId/has actualQuantity, any ingredient has actualQuantity > 0, any inventory_event with eventType='manufacturing_ingredient_consumption' references the MO/batch/ingredient, any inventory_event with eventType='manufacturing_output' references the MO/batch. Error messages start with 'Cannot delete manufacturing order {N} because production output has already been recorded' (or '...finalized ingredient consumption has already been recorded').
Filter `products.filter((product) => (bomByProduct.get(product.id) ?? []).length > 0)`. Only products with at least one current-revision BOM ingredient row are returned to the picker.

Soft-delete is blocked when the item is the productId of an open MO OR is referenced by manufacturingOrderIngredients.itemId on an open MO. Bulk message: 'Cannot delete: one or more items are used by open manufacturing orders.'

inferences.claim: Persistence-layer status enum is binary ('open'|'done') for both SO and MO, even though CLAUDE.md describes 'draft|released|completed|cancelled'. State distinctions are encoded by additional columns (completedAt, cancelledAt, deletedAt, actualQuantity) rather than the status string.

An MO is considered 'released' for the purpose of CLAUDE.md's invariant when status='open' AND completedAt is null AND deletedAt is null AND a pickAllocation or batch has progressed beyond 'pending'. Update is blocked at exactly this transition (pickAllocations or non-pending batches).
Cancellation of an MO sets deletedAt (and probably cancelledAt) — this reopens the salesOrderLineId one-time claim because the existing_active_mo filter excludes deleted rows.

The salesOrderLineId snapshot is intentionally not FK-backed so that updateSalesOrder can hard-delete + re-insert lines without violating constraints, and the snapshot retention path in validateSalesLineLinkInTx is the explicit fallback that keeps an MO linked when its original SO line has been rewritten but the new line has the same {salesOrderId, productId}.
POST /api/manufacturing-orders may produce duplicates on test retry because it does not require an Idempotency-Key. Sales POST does. This may matter for flake handling in retry-heavy tests.

Product picker in the new-MO form filters out products with empty BOMs. A product whose only BOM ingredient is then soft-deleted should disappear from the picker; this rule is implemented at getManufacturingProductTemplates (filter on bomCoverage length).

Item soft-delete block applies symmetrically: deletes are blocked whether the item is used as a finished product OR as an ingredient on any non-deleted, open MO. This matches CLAUDE.md's 'finished product OR ingredient snapshot row' description.
